interpretation: These documented examples show the literary connection did not disappear after1980. They do not statistically disprove a claim that adaptations became less prevalent, nor establish a remake-driven decline. Distinguish remembered critical periodisation from a measured industry-wide trend.
suitable_concise_synthesis: The relationship continued through Parbati Ghose’s1986FakirMohan adaptation, MangluCharanBiswal’s play reaching the Sambalpuri screen in Bhukha, and later films drawing on writers including KapileswarPrasadMohapatra and GourahariDas. Ananta returned to FakirMohan in2025. Their existence establishes continuity; frequency and industry share remain separate research questions.
